description: This Dart file defines the database abstraction layer for notes in a Flutter application. It includes a main class NotesDatabase that chooses between a platform-specific implementation: SQLite via sqflite on mobile/desktop, or an in-memory database fallback for web. It also defines the interfaces and classes required for database operations, as well as a lightweight in-memory database implementation for web preview purposes.

classes.name: NotesDatabase
classes.description: Main class that abstracts database persistence. Chooses implementation based on platform (web or non-web).

classes.name: _NotesDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface defining database operations that implementations must provide.

classes.name: _SqfliteNotesDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Implementation using sqflite for mobile/desktop platforms, creating and managing an SQLite database.

classes.name: _InMemoryNotesDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Web fallback implementation using an in-memory database that mimics sqflite API.

classes.name: _FakeWebDatabase
classes.description: Minimal in-memory database implementation supporting basic queries for web environment.

classes.name: _FakeWebBatch
classes.description: Batch operations for the in-memory web database.

methods.name: NotesDatabase
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database implementation based on platform.

methods.name: _NotesDatabaseImpl.database
methods.description: Returns a Future of the database instance.

methods.name: _NotesDatabaseImpl.notifyChanged
methods.description: Notifies listeners that data has changed.

methods.name: _SqfliteNotesDatabaseImpl.database
methods.description: Opens or returns existing SQLite database, creating tables if necessary.
